U042-S3.name: generated:U042-S3
U042-S3.description:
"Paid exactly once" is enforced by the database, not by hope

risk: idempotency (priority P0)
purpose: Confirm the single-use decision claim and the effect ledger's commit-once/live-hold constraints exist structurally in the live workspace DB, so a replayed approval cannot record a second decision or reserve the same effect twice.

product principle: outcome_verification
rationale: Single payment turns on a unique claim key plus a single-commitment ledger index; if either constraint is absent, a double-tap or retry can double-pay.

U042-S4.name: generated:U042-S4
U042-S4.description:
Approval and claim state is tenant-first, so another tenant cannot see or claim it

risk: cross_tenant (priority P0)
purpose: Confirm the decision claim table, the audit/decision event table, and the effect ledger are keyed tenant-first in the live DB, so one tenant's queued invoice-write intent or single-use claim is neither visible nor claimable by another tenant.
requirement: U-042 AC: an invoice belonging to another tenant is never visible or approvable
product principle: authority_clarity
rationale: Tenant isolation for approvals is a structural property of the keys; a claim keyed on action_id alone would let one tenant's approval consume another's, and a non-tenant-first event key would leak decisions across tenants.
